effect.name: Halftone Dots
effect.desc: Replaces the layer with a two-color halftone dot screen: a rotated sine grid is thresholded against source luminance, so source color is discarded and only the two chosen colors remain. Controls cover dot frequency, angle, relative width, edge sharpness, brightness bias, black or white dots, a 3x3 source smoothing pass, pattern shift and output alpha.
